title: Learning
subtitle: Knowledge-backed courses, practice, mastery, and spaced review
tagsNewPlaceholder: Type a tag name and press Enter
tagsApplyToChildren: Also append these tags to every question under this course
generateHint: AI designs a course blueprint first, then writes each lesson as a long-form study document (about 1000-1500 characters) with practice activities. Generation runs multiple model calls and takes about 1-3 minutes; please wait.
generateStarted: Generation started; track progress in the Generation Jobs tab
jobCancelRequested: Cancellation requested; it will stop after the current stage
jobRetryHint: Optional: pick the model for this retry (defaults to the job's original model; switch when the default model is busy)
jobDeleteConfirm: Delete this generation job? This cannot be undone
courseDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the course you want, e.g. Master Rust ownership and lifetimes
noKnowledgeBases: No usable knowledge bases yet; choose "Auto-create a knowledge base"
createViaAgentHint: On submit you will be taken to the AI chat page and a message will be sent automatically: the AI first ensures the base has well-structured Markdown documents (writing them when missing), then generates the course.
createViaAgentStarted: Taking you to the AI chat to create the course automatically
describeRequired: Describe the course you want to create first
noUsableKnowledgeBases: No available knowledge base contains Markdown documents
domainPlaceholder: For example: futures trading, linear algebra

form.modelSelectTooltip: AI model used by learning (reflection grading, course generation, job retry; defaults to the system default)
form.modelUnavailableHint: This explicitly configured model is no longer available. Choose another model or Default Model.

importHint: Paste CoursePack JSON. A pack may reference a knowledge base and source paths.
deleteCourseReviews: Also delete its review questions and learning data
deleteCourseReviewsOn: Review history, mastery, lesson progress and all course content will be removed permanently.
deleteCourseReviewsOff: Course content and questions are kept, so its concepts stay in the review queue (shown as "Deleted course").
questionStateUnlearnedHint: Not in queue: this question is not in the review queue yet. Completing its lesson auto-queues it with the concept.
questionStateNewHint: First review: the card is in the review queue, waiting for its first review.
questionStateDueHint: Due: the review card is due and can be reviewed now.
questionStateScheduledHint: Scheduled: the review card is not due yet; it joins today's review session once due.
questionQueueLegend: Not in queue = this question's lesson is not completed yet; First review = queued, awaiting first review; Due / Scheduled = enters today's review by due time.
questionQueueHintIn: This question's concept has a review card; it joins today's review session when due, and your rating reschedules the next review.
questionQueueHintOut: This question is not in the review queue yet: completing its lesson auto-queues it with the concept.
questionQueueHintCustom: Custom questions follow their own schedule and join today's review session when due.
questionCreated: Question added; it is ready to review right away
questionConceptBindHint: Linking only groups the question; it does not change its review schedule.
questionPromptRequired: The prompt must not be empty
questionOptionsRequired: At least two non-empty options are required
questionAnswerHint: Click the radio button next to an option to mark it as the correct answer
questionDeleteHint: This removes the review card only; the original activity inside the course is kept. Continue?
questionDeleteCustomHint: This permanently removes the custom question and its review schedule. Continue?
questionDistractorsHint: Near-synonym traps (optional): surface confusable terms; not used for grading
questionFillBlankHint: Mark the blank with ___ in the prompt
questionFillBlankHintRequired: Mark the blank with ___ in the prompt
noCourseReviews: No review cards are due for this course
noCourses: No courses yet. Generate one from a knowledge base or import a course pack.
noDiagnosticQuestions: This course has no objective questions available for diagnosis
diagnosticComplete: Diagnostic complete. Your recommended path now reflects your mastery.
recommendationReason: Recommended from current mastery and prerequisite order
allConceptsMastered: Your diagnostic evidence meets the mastery threshold for every course concept. Continue with review or applied practice.
sourceUnavailable: This course is not linked to a knowledge base, so no source text is available
reviewSkipped: Skipped — it will come back tomorrow
reviewForgotMarked: Marked as "forgot"; it will return shortly.
reviewRatePrompt: Correct. Rate how hard it was to recall:
reviewWrongMarkedAgain: Incorrect. Marked as "forgot"; it will return shortly.
packContract: A course pack contains Course, Module, Lesson, Concept, Activity, and SourceSpan. Domain evaluators extend this kernel.

settings.title: Learning
settings.description: Memory-curve scheduler (FSRS) and review queue preferences
settings.desiredRetentionHint: Higher values schedule reviews sooner and more often (0.7–0.99, default 0.9)
settings.fsrsParametersHint: Comma-separated numbers. Leave empty to use the FSRS defaults; useful for importing optimized parameters from Anki.
settings.parametersInvalid: FSRS parameters must all be finite numbers
settings.reviewSessionLimitHint: Maximum due review cards loaded per session
settings.diagnosticLimitHint: Maximum questions sampled per knowledge diagnostic
